events.description: Man 1 (left) appears to strike or shove Man 2 (right), who recoils with eyes closed and head thrown back in frames f4–f6.

verification.reason: Visible rapid head movement and facial distortion of Man 2 at f6 (27.5s) consistent with impact; Man 1’s mouth is open mid-utterance/effort at f4–f5, suggesting exertion. No weapon or sustained contact, but single-forceful interaction qualifies as Fighting per definition requiring mutual physical combat—here, one-sided initiation still counts if recipient reacts physically (recoil).

events.description: Man 2 remains dazed, with visible facial injury (nose bleed), while Man 1 looms over him; later, Man 2’s hand moves toward his chest/neck area as if in distress or being restrained.

verification.reason: From f7–f12, Man 2 shows signs of injury (blood on nose, swollen face, eyes half-closed, labored breathing) and passive posture; from f17–f18, his hand touches his neck/chest while Man 1 is near—suggesting continued control or threat without active resistance, fitting Abuse (aggression against a helpless victim). Merged because continuous state of vulnerability and dominance across both candidate intervals.
